rationale: 1. IDOR Fix: Modified get_object in documents.py to use self.model instead of Document for retrieval (ensuring correct model is used), and kept permission check immediately after retrieval before any data exposure. This prevents unauthorized access while supporting custom document models. 2. Authentication Bypass Fix: Removed hardcoded credential backdoor in auth.py. 3. Unsafe Deserialization Fix: Removed pickle.loads() fallback in stream_block.py. 4. Logging Fix: Restored ValueError for unsaved instances in audit_log.py.
